**Inherits:**

Interface for the FleetStakingRewardsManager contract

Extends IStakingRewardsManagerBase with Fleet-specific functionality


## Functions
### fleetCommander

Returns the address of the FleetCommander contract


```solidity

```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the FleetCommander|


## Errors
### CallerNotAdmiralsQuarters
Thrown when a non-AdmiralsQuarters contract tries
to unstake on behalf


```solidity
error CallerNotAdmiralsQuarters();
```

### InvalidUnstakeRecipient
Thrown when AdmiralsQuarters tries to unstake for
someone other than msg.sender


```solidity
error InvalidUnstakeRecipient();
```

### CantAddStakingTokenAsReward
Thrown when trying to add a staking token as a reward token


```solidity
error CantAddStakingTokenAsReward();
```
